errors.evidence: The description for the Centrum (5%) line (dashed yellow) provides consistently incorrect values. In the figure, this line starts at approximately 15.6, stays at approximately 15.6 at x=16, and ends at approximately 15.7 at x=64. The reported values of 15.8, 15.8, and 15.9 are all too high and misrepresent the data for this line.
The solid green PELMS line reaches a value of approximately 18.6 at x=16, which is visibly more than halfway between 18.0 and 19.0. The reported value of 18.4 is an inaccurate approximation.
